reason: The plugin adds a workspace menu action that launches VS Code or another configured editor CLI for the selected workspace directory; the README states it has no tools, model-facing surface, or file read/write behavior.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区菜单中添加“在 VSCode 中打开”操作，并通过配置的编辑器命令启动所选工作区目录。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an Open in VS Code action to DeepSeek Harness workspace menus and launches the selected directory with a configured editor command.

capabilities: Adds an Open in VS Code menu action for workspace directories
Invokes a configured editor CLI on a user-selected workspace directory
Uses a host-client remote call to launch the editor process
